title: Relationships 2.0: Why Did You Do That?

sentences.en: All parents have moments when their kids test their patience.
sentences.zh: 所有父母都有被孩子磨掉耐心的时候。

sentences.en: I often yell at my kids for things that they did by accident,
sentences.zh: 我经常因为孩子们无意中做错的事对他们大吼大叫，

sentences.en: like spilling a smoothie or leaving a cap off of a permanent marker
sentences.zh: 比如打翻了冰沙，或者把记号笔的笔帽弄丢了，

sentences.en: and, you know, making black permanent stains all over the sofa.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，把整个沙发弄得到处都是黑色的永久性污渍。

sentences.en: When this happens and the couch is covered in black splotches
sentences.zh: 每当这种事情发生，沙发上布满了黑色的斑块，

sentences.en: or their smoothie on the floor,
sentences.zh: 或者他们的冰沙洒在地板上，

sentences.en: the perpetrators inevitably offer this defense.
sentences.zh: 肇事者难免会这样辩解。

sentences.en: I didn't mean to do it.
I shouldn't say this, but I tell them,
sentences.zh: 我本不该这么说，但我告诉他们：

sentences.en: it doesn't matter that you didn't mean to do it.
sentences.zh: 你不是故意的并不重要。

sentences.en: What matters is that you won't do it again.
sentences.zh: 重要的是你不能再犯第二次。

sentences.en: Lian's reaction, while understandable, is deeply ironic.
sentences.zh: 连的反应虽然可以理解，但却极其讽刺。

sentences.en: She's a psychologist who studies how we read other people's intentions.
sentences.zh: 她是一位心理学家，专门研究我们如何揣摩他人的意图。

sentences.en: We need to think about other people's minds in order to figure out
sentences.zh: 我们需要思考他人的想法，以便弄清楚

sentences.en: who our friends are, who to avoid, whom to punish, whether to punish.
sentences.zh: 谁是我们的朋友、该避开谁、该惩罚谁、是否应该惩罚。

sentences.en: And we need to read people's intentions in any ordinary interaction,
sentences.zh: 在任何日常互动中，我们都需要揣摩人们的意图，

sentences.en: like having a conversation and figuring out what to say and how to respond.
sentences.zh: 比如进行对话，琢磨该说些什么以及如何回应。

sentences.en: As we go through life, we are constantly making sense of people's actions
sentences.zh: 在我们的人生旅途中，我们不断地通过解读他人的意图

sentences.en: Our ability to read what is happening in other people's minds
sentences.zh: 我们洞察他人内心的能力

sentences.en: is like an invisible compass guiding us through life.
sentences.zh: 就像一个隐形的指南针，指引我们走过一生。

sentences.en: But sometimes it leads us astray.
sentences.zh: 但有时它也会把我们带入歧途。

sentences.en: We misread other people's intentions, especially when we're angry or hurt.
sentences.zh: 我们会误解他人的意图，尤其是当我们愤怒或受伤的时候。

sentences.en: In the last few weeks, in our Relationships 2.0 series,
sentences.zh: 在过去几周的“人际关系 2.0”系列节目中，

sentences.en: we've looked at the importance of human connection
sentences.zh: 我们探讨了人类连接的重要性

sentences.en: and how we can become better negotiators.
sentences.zh: 以及我们如何才能成为更好的谈判者。

sentences.en: If you missed those episodes, do check them out.
sentences.zh: 如果你错过了那些节目，一定要去听听。
本周的《隐藏的大脑》将探讨：

sentences.en: how our powers of observation allow us to navigate our social worlds
sentences.zh: 我们的观察力如何帮助我们在社交世界中游刃有余，
直到它们不再灵验之时。

sentences.en: We are constantly trying to read other people's minds.
sentences.zh: 我们时刻都在试图揣摩他人的心思。

sentences.en: When we interact with friends, relatives, and co-workers,
sentences.zh: 当我们与朋友、亲戚和同事互动时，

sentences.en: what is going on in this other person's head?
sentences.zh: 这个人的脑子里在想什么？

sentences.en: Our ability to read other minds involves an extraordinary feat of cognition.
sentences.zh: 我们揣摩他人心思的能力涉及一项非凡的认知壮举。

sentences.en: Yet, it mostly unfolds in our heads without us being aware of it.
sentences.zh: 然而，它大多在我们的脑海中展开，而我们却浑然不觉。

sentences.en: the simplest of interactions would be mired in confusion and misunderstanding.
sentences.zh: 最简单的互动也会陷入混乱和误解之中。

sentences.en: Li-Anne Yang is a psychologist and neuroscientist at Boston College.
sentences.zh: 莉安·杨是波士顿学院的心理学家和神经科学家。

sentences.en: She has spent years studying this mental ability
sentences.zh: 她花了很多年时间研究这种心理能力

sentences.en: and the profound effects it has on our lives.
sentences.zh: 以及它对我们生活的深远影响。

sentences.en: Li-Anne Yang, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 莉安·杨，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: It's good to be here, Shankar.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里，尚卡尔。

sentences.en: I want to start with a very simple example
sentences.zh: 我想从一个非常简单的例子开始，

sentences.en: that shows how important it is for us to read what's happening
sentences.zh: 它展示了解读他人内心活动

sentences.en: in the minds of other people.
In the 1993 movie Mrs. Doubtfire starring Robin Williams,
sentences.zh: 在 1993 年由罗宾·威廉姆斯主演的电影《窈窕奶爸》中，

sentences.en: the characters Daniel and Miranda have split up
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔和米兰达这两个角色分居了，

sentences.en: and Daniel comes up with this unconventional way to win Miranda back.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔想出了一个非同寻常的方法来重新赢得米兰达的芳心。

sentences.en: He returns to the house in disguise as Mrs. Doubtfire,
sentences.zh: 他乔装打扮成道布菲尔太太回到家中，

sentences.en: an elderly widow who seeks the role of nanny and housekeeper.
sentences.zh: 这是一位希望应聘保姆和管家职务的老寡妇。

sentences.en: Now, he quickly wins the trust of the family.
sentences.zh: 很快，他就赢得了这个家庭的信任。

sentences.en: Very soon, Miranda is asking Mrs. Doubtfire for life advice,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，米兰达开始向道布菲尔太太寻求生活建议，

sentences.en: including whether to go on a date with a man she's just met.
sentences.zh: 包括是否要和一个刚认识的男人约会。

sentences.en: Mrs. Doubtfire, may I ask you a question?
sentences.zh: 道布菲尔太太，我能问你一个问题吗？

sentences.en: How long after Mr. Doubtfire passed away?
sentences.zh: 道布菲尔先生去世多久了？

sentences.en: Winston, did you feel any desire?
sentences.zh: 温斯顿，你可曾有过任何渴望？

sentences.en: Once the father of your children is out of the picture,
sentences.zh: 一旦你孩子的父亲从你的生活中消失了，

sentences.en: the only solution is total and lifelong celibacy.
sentences.zh: 唯一的解决办法就是彻底且终身的独身。

sentences.en: So, Leanne, if we lack the capacity to read what was happening inside the minds of Daniel and Miranda,
sentences.zh: 那么，莉安，如果我们缺乏揣摩丹尼尔和米兰达内心想法的能力，

sentences.en: how would that change how we understood this scene?
sentences.zh: 那会如何改变我们对这个场景的理解？

sentences.en: Well, I think we wouldn't be able to appreciate the humor and the irony in that scene where Daniel is,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我们将无法体会那个场景中的幽默和讽刺，当时丹尼尔

sentences.en: essentially, he knows what is going on with his wife,

sentences.zh: 并且他正试图阻止他的妻子和这个别的男人约会。

sentences.en: And, of course, we know that the wife doesn't know Daniel's true identity as Daniel.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们知道妻子并不知道丹尼尔的真实身份就是丹尼尔。

sentences.en: She thinks that he is this housekeeper, and we know that she doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 她以为他是这个管家，而且我们知道她并不知道真相。

sentences.en: And so there's this very sort of layered understanding that we need to have as the audience
sentences.zh: 因此，作为观众，我们需要具备这种非常具有层次感的理解，
才能觉得这个场景很有趣。

sentences.en: We can't find it funny without realizing that she doesn't know what he knows and who he is.
sentences.zh: 如果我们没有意识到她不知道他知道什么、他是谁，我们就不会觉得好笑。

sentences.en: So we're able to read in some ways that he has an agenda here
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，我们能看出他在这里有着某种目的，

sentences.en: because he wants to keep his wife from dating other men.
sentences.zh: 因为他想阻止他的妻子与别的男人约会。

sentences.en: And we also understand that she doesn't know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我们也明白她并不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: But what's interesting to me, Leanne, is that we intuit all of this effortlessly.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说有趣的是，莉安，我们毫不费力地就能直觉到这一切。

sentences.en: No one sits down as they're watching the movie and actually says to themselves,
sentences.zh: 没有人会在看电影时坐下来，然后对自己说：

sentences.en: all right, this is what's going through his head, this is what's going through her head.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这是他脑子里想的，这是她脑子里想的。

sentences.en: It's the fact we're able to take it in so effortlessly that allows us to understand the scene.
sentences.zh: 正是因为我们能够如此不费力地吸收这些信息，我们才能理解这个场景。
所以我们能够做到这一点。

sentences.zh: 所以你刚才用了一个术语，心理理论。

sentences.zh: 这是你和其他研究人员用来描述我们理解

sentences.zh: 你能向我解释一下这个术语是什么意思吗？

sentences.zh: 所以我应该说明，许多心理学家和神经科学家使用了许多不同的术语。

sentences.en: Theory of mind is one of those terMs.
sentences.zh: 心理理论就是其中之一。

sentences.en: And that describes the theory that we all have, ordinary people have, about other people's minds.
sentences.zh: 它描述了我们所有人、普通人对他人内心世界的理论认识。

sentences.en: And what I mean by that is how we understand that other people have thoughts, beliefs,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们如何理解其他人拥有思想、信念、

sentences.en: desires, and intentions, mental states in general.
sentences.zh: 愿望和意图，也就是总体的心理状态。

sentences.en: And so other terms that have been used for this general cognitive capacity
sentences.zh: 因此，用于描述这种普遍认知能力的其他术语

sentences.en: include mental state reasoning, mentalizing, reasoning about intentions, and so on.
sentences.zh: 包括心理状态推理、心智化、意图推理等等。

sentences.en: And again, the fact that we do it so effortlessly, you know, many of us don't even realize that we're
sentences.zh: 同样，我们做起来毫不费力这一事实，你知道的，我们许多人甚至没有意识到我们在

sentences.zh: 我们许多人没有意识到，如果我们正在交谈，却无法直觉到

sentences.en: Even as you and I are having this conversation, Shankar, I'm trying to figure out, you know,

sentences.en: what it is that you want to know and how to explain the term theory of mind in a way that will be

而且有时在对话过程中，我们会从人们那里捕捉到不同的信号，比如他们

sentences.zh: 是否在点头，是否在停顿，看起来是否困惑，等等。

我们不仅能够走入角色的内心，还能走进

Psychologists are able to administer batteries of theory of mind tasks to young children to
figure out when exactly it is that individual children are able to think about other agents

则拥有一个错误的想法。

So she'll think it's in the block.
